title: Sultanate iqta and army
quote: Alauddin = cash pay, dagh and huliya; Firoz = hereditary iqtas

boxes.title: Iqta system
items: **Iqta** = land revenue assigned instead of cash salary; ==not ownership of land==
Muqti: kept troops, collected revenue, law & order; sent surplus (**fawazil**) to centre
First grant: **Hansi**, by **Muhammad Ghori** to **Aibak** (⚠ other notes: Kuhram)

items.what: Organised system; iqtas to Turkish officers
Tried to resume old soldiers' iqtas; **khwajas** audit muqtis
==First large standing army paid in **cash**==; enlarged **khalisa**
Inquiry into grants; unlawful grants seized
Iqtas ==**hereditary**==; jagir revival hurt army efficiency

boxes.title: Army & dagh-huliya
items: Stopped substandard horses, proxies; **Sher Shah** revived dagh
Cavalry = core arm; Alauddin's cavalry about **4,75,000** (Ferishta)
Turkish: mounted archers, **iron stirrup**, armour; horses from West Asia
